issue_context.title: Brother MFC-8660DN Restarting with Home Assistant running
issue_context.body:
### The problem

**This started ever since brother integration was introduced.( I do not remember what version)** 

### Before 2021.7.0

**With Brother integration disabled.**

- Brother MFC-8660dn restarts every time I restart HA. 

**With Brother integration enabled.**

- Brother MFC-8660dn to HA it will periodically restart. 
- The printer will also not print. 
- Every time I try to print the printer will keep rebooting. 

### With 2021.7.0 and newer

- Even if I don't have the integration added and/or have it disabled it will continue to restart periodically as long as home assistant is running. However with the integration disabled I am able to print. It has become such a nuisance that I had to disable the printer's SNMP service to avoid having to listen to the printer constantly restart. 

I do not need brother printer to be integrated with home assistant and I understand the 8660dn is a very old printer, but can something be done about the constant restarting?

(note: I have another Brother printer that is NOT affected by this issue at all. Brother MFC-9340DW)

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.7.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Brother Printer

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/brother/

```yaml
logger:
  default: warning
  logs:
    homeassistant.components.brother: debug
    brother: debug
```
